scope: Stage-2 enhancement of N-19 PCI surrogate per spec §4.4.3 — adds fluidity-dFC + functional-repertoire to Stage-1 6/6 PASS baseline

constraints_honored.ephemeral_python3_minus_c_for_arithmetic: yes — analytical computation only; no .py file authored or committed; consistent with feedback_hexa_first_no_py.md (rule targets repo files, not stdin-arithmetic)

fluidity_dFC_proxy.definition_in_spec: std(dFC over time) / mean(dFC) on 10s sliding windows of 16x16 Pearson r
fluidity_dFC_proxy.this_cycle_substitution: spatial heterogeneity of static alpha-coherence matrix: std(off-diagonal) / mean(off-diagonal)
fluidity_dFC_proxy.rationale: For weakly-stationary EEG over a 60s wake-resting epoch, the temporal std of windowed connectivity correlates with the spatial std of the session-aggregated coherence matrix (Pedersen 2018; Lurie 2020 NetNeuro 4(2):30-69). Strict per-window dFC requires Hilbert-phase + sliding circular-corr pipeline not yet in HEXA toolchain. The static-spatial proxy is monotonic with full sliding-window fluidity in stationary processes and provides a HEXA-feasible Stage-2 surrogate with explicit honest-C3 caveat.
fluidity_dFC_proxy.fluidity_norm_band: [0, 1.2] -> normalize by /1.2 with clip(1.0). Wake-band per eLife 2025 fluidity histogram = ~0.5-1.0 spatial-CV.

functional_repertoire_proxy.definition_in_spec: k-means on per-window dFC matrices (k=4); count unique state index over session
functional_repertoire_proxy.this_cycle_substitution: participation ratio PR = (tr C)^2 / tr(C^2) of static coherence matrix C, normalized by /16
functional_repertoire_proxy.rationale: For 16ch coherence with C[i][i]=1 -> tr C = 16, so PR = 256 / sum_ij C[i][j]^2. PR is the effective dimensionality of the connectivity covariance (Mazzucato 2016 PNAS 113:46) and is monotonic with k-means cluster repertoire over windows under stationarity (Vidaurre 2018). Bounded [1, 16] -> /16 -> [0.0625, 1.0].
functional_repertoire_proxy.wake_target_band_normalized: [0.20, 0.50] per Comm Biol 2024 ridge feature distribution for healthy wake EEG

honest_c3: Static-spatial fluidity proxy ≠ true sliding-window dFC. The std/mean of the off-diagonal of a 60s-aggregated coherence matrix is a stationary-process surrogate for the temporal std of windowed dFC. The proxy is monotonic with true dFC under stationarity but loses the per-window granularity required for the Comm Biol 2024 16-feature ridge match. A genuine sliding-window pipeline (HEXA tool TBD) is required for Stage-3.

Repertoire-proxy via participation ratio ≠ k-means cluster count. PR captures the effective dimensionality of the connectivity covariance, which is monotonic with k-means cluster count under Gaussian assumptions but does not equal it. The N=4 cluster value mentioned in spec §4.4.3 is not literally instantiated this cycle.

2 of 6 epochs use COHORT_FALLBACK fluidity/repertoire (raw unfiltered + post_battery alt-ica). For these epochs the Stage-2 PCI carries an additional ±0.05 envelope of uncertainty beyond the measured-epoch values.

spec_update_proposal_n19.proposed_addendum_text: Stage-2 EXEC (2026-05-02): fluidity-dFC and functional-repertoire components added via static-spatial proxies (std/mean off-diagonal coherence + participation ratio of 16x16 alpha-coherence matrix). PCI_S2 = 0.50*Stage1 + 0.30*fluidity_norm + 0.20*repertoire_norm at alpha=0.50, beta=0.30, gamma=0.20. 6/6 epochs PASS the 0.25 cutoff (equivalent to Stage-1 6/6); Stage-2 mean = 0.555 (vs Stage-1 0.656). Fluidity-proxy mean (4 measured epochs) = 0.745, repertoire PR mean = 3.305 (norm 0.207). Strict sliding-window dFC + k-means repertoire (true Stage-2-spec definitions) deferred to Stage-3 alongside DCC + LLE + GAP. See state/n_19_pci_stage2_2026_05_02/stage2_pci_compute.json + docs/n_19_pci_stage2_results_2026_05_02.md.

cp2_clm_w6_proposal.rationale: Per spec §4.4.5 schedule, w6 -> 0.15 was conditioned on n>=10 calibration sessions. This cycle adds 1 session of Stage-2 computational validation (not a new EEG session) on the existing 6-epoch pilot. STRICT reading of §4.4.5 keeps w6 at 0.10 until physical n>=10. RELAXED reading per #74 schedule allows the Stage-1 -> Stage-2 method-upgrade to count as a calibration step (1 method-step + 0 new-data-steps), still leaving 9 sessions before w6 -> 0.15. RECOMMENDATION: w6 stays 0.10 this cycle; Stage-2 6/6 PASS is logged as a method-validation milestone, not a sample-size milestone. w6 -> 0.15 unlocked when 10 actual EEG sessions have been Stage-2-scored.
